Producers Guild of America Awards|26th]] }} The '''25th Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2014 Producers Guild Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2013, were held at [[The Beverly Hilton|The Beverly Hilton Hotel]] in [[Beverly Hills, California]] on January 19, 2014.{{cite news|title=2014 PGA Awards: Winners and Nominees|url=https://variety.com/2014/film/news/2014-pga-awards-nominees-1201064599/|accessdate=February 9, 2018|work=Variety|date=January 19, 2014}}{{cite web |title=2014 Producers Guild Awards Winners |url=https://www.producersguild.org/news/153353/2014-Producers-Guild-Awards-Winners.htm |publisher=Producers Guild of America |accessdate=July 8, 2018 |date=January 20, 2014}} The nominees for documentary motion picture were announced on November 26, 2013.{{cite web |title=Producers Guild Announces Documentary Film Nominees |url=https://deadline.com/2013/11/producers-guild-announces-documentary-film-nominees-644235/ |website=Deadline Hollywood |accessdate=July 8, 2018 |date=November 26, 2013}} The nominees for television and digital series were announced on December 3, 2013.{{cite web |title=PGA Awards Unveils TV Nominees |url=https://deadline.com/2013/12/tv-nominees-for-pga-awards-unveiled-646308/ |website=Deadline Hollywood |accessdate=July 8, 2018 |date=December 3, 2018}} The nominees for motion picture, animated feature, and long-form television were announced on January 2, 2014.{{cite web|url=http://www.producersguild.org/news/151419/|title=Nominations for Theatrical Motion Picture, Animated Theatrical Motion Picture and Long-Form TV|date=January 2, 2014|publisher=[[Producers Guild
